target: ADR 0003 decision 6 -- the declared datum/evidence observation link, and the claim it withholds
note: The ruling for this slice named two protections that must be mutation-killed: the explicit observation link, and the success-withholding guard. Both are below, plus the three neighbouring rules whose failure would read as success -- the MEASURED-only restriction, the absent-key rule that keeps every stored contract hash still, and the do-not-overwrite-a-finding half of the withholding guard. Every entry was run against the real code and observed to fail the named tests. Run with: uv run python tools/mutate.py benchmarks/mutations/adr0003-decision6.json

mutations.name: the-observation-link-is-inferred-not-declared
mutations.anchor:
observed = (requirement.observes_datum_id or "").strip()
        if not observed or observed not in referenced:
mutations.why: the derivation stops reading the declared link and pairs any measurement with whatever datum a scope references, so a MEASURED row that never claimed to observe anything withholds the job's claim -- an authority relationship invented by the tool, which is exactly what the ruling forbade

mutations.name: the-loader-drops-the-observation-link
mutations.why: the production defect this slice shipped and review caught: as_dict writes the link and the loader dropped it, so a saved project reloads without an observation, datum_conflicts reports agreement, and a real CLI run claims success over the disagreement -- invisible to every fixture that built Requirement objects in memory

mutations.name: a-success-is-claimed-over-an-unresolved-conflict
mutations.why: the conflict is reported in the payload and the job says COMMISSIONED anyway, which is the worst combination a receipt can carry: a true claim about the geometry beside a disagreement nobody resolved

mutations.name: a-conflict-overwrites-a-real-failure
mutations.why: a FAILED geometry becomes NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE because a datum disagrees, hiding a real defect behind a bookkeeping one -- the failure the lane cap's comment warns about, one guard over

mutations.name: any-provenance-may-claim-to-observe-a-datum
mutations.why: a STATED or CHOSEN row may declare itself an observation of a datum, which makes the conflict a disagreement between two opinions rather than between a reference and evidence -- two authorities for one number, which is what 6.5 exists to prevent

mutations.name: the-absent-key-becomes-a-null
mutations.why: every requirement in the repository gains an observes_datum_id: null, and since requirements are covered by requirement_sha256 that moves every stored contract hash and every recorded replay -- for rows with nothing to do with this slice
